title: Bud as best singer and the vocal quartet
summary: No one could match Bud, and the band had a quartet with McAllister singing tenor.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: Uh, Bud was just about the best around here. And, uh, we had, uh, a boy used to sing with them. We had a quartet. I was singing tenor. Bud was leading. Walter King was, uh, singing baritone. And H. Shaw was, uh, H. Shaw was singing baritone. And, uh, his son was singing, uh, bass. We had a pretty good quartet. But, uh, singing, uh, we ain't had anyone around here that could be Bud singing.
